articles.title: Amazon Japan supplier AZ-Com Maruwa to adopt yen stablecoin JPYC for payments
articles.snippet: The Japanese logistics firm plans to pay 2,300 partners, including truck drivers, using JPYC in Japan’s first large-scale corporate stablecoin rollout.

articles.title: The GENIUS Act turns 1: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: The stablecoin-focused GENIUS Act became a law a year ago.

articles.title: Allbridge pauses cross-chain bridge after $1.65M exploit
articles.snippet: The attacker allegedly used a flash loan and rapid swaps to manipulate the bridge’s stablecoin exchange rate.

articles.title: Japanese logistics company eyes JPYC stablecoin to pay drivers
articles.snippet: The planned rollout would let thousands of transportation contractors receive digital yen payments more frequently and quickly.

articles.title: US agencies miss GENIUS Act deadline for final stablecoin rules
articles.snippet: US regulators failed to finalize implementing regulations by the GENIUS Act’s one-year deadline, issuing 10 proposed rules instead.
